WITH valid_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
consumer_names AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_last_name, c_first_name
    FROM customer
),
store_channel AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT consumer_names.c_last_name, consumer_names.c_first_name, valid_dates.d_date
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN valid_dates ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = valid_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN consumer_names ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = consumer_names.c_customer_sk
),
catalog_channel AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT consumer_names.c_last_name, consumer_names.c_first_name, valid_dates.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN valid_dates ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = valid_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN consumer_names ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = consumer_names.c_customer_sk
),
web_channel AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT consumer_names.c_last_name, consumer_names.c_first_name, valid_dates.d_date
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN valid_dates ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = valid_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN consumer_names ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = consumer_names.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM store_channel
    INTERSECT
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM catalog_channel
    INTERSECT
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM web_channel
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
